forWhat: Each child's parent report, line by line, in the educator's words. The list is on the left; a child's report opens on the right.
An educator of the class approves each line, then the coordinator does. Nothing goes out until both have and a parent's consent is on file.

layout.shows: Class and State. They narrow the list.
One table for each stage a report stands at. A child's name opens their report on the right.
With no child chosen, how many lines wait for you and how many reports were sent. A child chosen shows their report in tabs: Lines, Report and Approvals.

jobs.title: Approve a child's report
steps: On the Lines tab, read each line. To change one, edit its words and press [[Save words]].
Press [[Approve]] under each line. The coordinator gives the second approval.

buttons.label: Save words
buttons.does: Saves your words for that line.
buttons.doesNot: Any approval the line had is withdrawn, so it is read again.

buttons.label: Approve
buttons.does: Approves that one line, in your name.
